title: Logistics Team Leader (f/m/d)
description:
Lead a team of 14 in our warehouse for a consumer-goods customer.

What you'll do
- Allocate tasks, plan shifts and monitor service levels
- Train new team members and ensure safety standards
- Report KPIs to the site manager

What you bring
- 3+ years in warehouse operations, 1+ year leading a team
- Good command of English for reporting to the international site manager
- Forklift licence
